context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation refinement feature fully tested and working. Key behaviors: 1) Landing page (/) uses AnimatePresence to conditionally hide navbar (isLanding = pathname === '/'), showing only logo + theme toggle. 2) All feature pages (/notes, /planner, /practice, /history) show full navbar with staggered fade-in animation. 3) Home button removed from NAV_ITEMS. 4) Logo click always navigates to /. 5) Feature cards and CTAs on home page act as primary entry points to feature pages.
